messages:
midhun: quick ping — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7865 needs runtime + security eyes before canary. touches cache allocator heuristics + KMS usage. blocking merge until both OK.

deploy-bot: CI • unit ✅ • lint ✅ • e2e flaky (re-run queued) • perf-tests queued

erica: on it. can you paste the key config diff here? specifically the eviction/window/threshold bits and the new KMS call site.

midhun: sure — main change is lowering eviction aggressiveness for pinned allocations and deferring KMS calls behind a new rate-limiter. snippet below:
```diff
- eviction_window_ms = 100
- eviction_aggressiveness = 0.9
+ eviction_window_ms = 250  # allow longer life for pinned caches
+ eviction_aggressiveness = 0.6
@@
- call_kms(key_id)
+ if kms_rate_limiter.allow():
+     call_kms(key_id)
+ else:
+     log.info("kms rate-limited, deferring rotation", key_id=key_id)
```

jonathan: security quick check — does this change the path where key material is ever cached or exported? need to confirm there is no persistent key material written to disk. also please add an audit log entry for key_id usage.

midhun: no key material is cached; we only store key_id and ephemeral tokens. will add explicit audit log entry and a unit test asserting no key bytes are persisted.

liza: platform note — I can own canary tomorrow morning (07:30 PT). if runtime+security signoff, we can merge in the 08:00 canary window. please @ me when content is final.

erica: skimmed the change — runtime surface looks fine. one concern: on KV cache miss storms this could increase latency because we defer eviction longer. can we add a small throttling guard to limit concurrent refill ops? if you add that, I can approve.

jonathan: also need: sanitized logging for key_id usage, a short threat-model bullet in PR description, and an e2e perf measurement (tail latency) to show no regression. after that i can sign off.

midhun: will add throttling guard + audit logs + perf run. plan: push a follow-up commit to the same PR within ~30m and re-request reviews. thanks for the fast eyes.

erica: :thumbsup: once the guard is in i'll greenlight runtime.

liza: I'll book the canary slot tentatively. ping me again after tests pass and you're ready to merge.

midhun: done — pushing tests now, will update thread with artifacts (perf link + small PR description update). thanks everyone!
__notes: Follow-up approvals expected after small runtime guard and security logging are added. no title field per agents.md
